# Figure 4 — A3 transfer: which meter lines move when the books are carried

## Caption (this is what the paper prints)

**Figure 4. A3 transfer: which meter lines move when the books are carried.** The like-for-like level-2 comparison, meter line by meter line, control arm against transfer arm. The bottom three lines -- compile 1:1, certify 3:3, plan 1:1 -- do not move, and they are drawn for that reason: an axis that hid them would be measuring something other than transfer.
